repo.description:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

Authorization callouts return signed user credentials that can restrict the connection types a user is permitted to use.

### Problem Description

The callout authentication path did not enforce the effective user credential’s allowed connection types before accepting a connection. A credential intended for one transport or connection role could be used on another listener governed by the same callout. This could permit a leafnode connection where only ordinary client access was intended.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.14.9 and v2.15.2. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-724w-jvcm-4c58>
 * Credit: @SounLabs
repo.summary: Authorization callouts did not enforce allowed connection types
